article.title: California’s Tallest and Most Iconic Trees Are Getting Heatstroke
article.summary:
A grove of coast redwood trees is a forest of forests.
This means trees are slowing their “breathing” and “eating” because they can’t cool down fast enough when temperatures rise.
Trees use the pores in their leaves, stomata, to do two things: take carbon dioxide in, and let water out.
Open stomata mean the tree is “breathing” in carbon dioxide and photosynthesizing, but probably also letting water out.
Closed stomata mean the tree is conserving water but also slowing down its photosynthesis, since it isn’t taking in any carbon dioxide.

article.title: Miliband says Britain won't tolerate threats on our soil, as Iran ambassador summoned
article.summary:
The foreign secretary has summoned the Iranian ambassador to make clear that "Britain will not tolerate threats on our soil" following last month's incident at RAF Fairford.
Ed Miliband said attempts by Iran to undermine the UK's security "through its criminal networks, proxy groups and state-backed malign activity is unacceptable".
Iran's ambassador to the UK, Seyed Ali Mousavi, said Tehran was not involved and was willing to cooperate with British authorities.
In July, Iran said "any base used for aggression against Iranian territory constitutes a legitimate target for our forces".
RAF Fairford, in the Cotswolds, has been used as a forward operating location by the US air force for decades.
